MLA Standard: MLA.MAR.LAB.02

Lesson quiz bank item 22.
Lesson focus: Ocean Maps, Models, and Data Displays
Stimulus: Map/model/data stimulus

A systems question asks how one change affects another part of the marine system. Which answer uses the marine evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Read the map title, scale, and legend. Then use the required stimulus (Map/model/data stimulus) to connect the visible evidence to ocean maps, bathymetry, sonar evidence, scale, and seafloor features. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.MAR.LAB.02 and avoids this common mistake: reading a marine map as a picture instead of using scale, labels, depth, and evidence.

answer.text: marine maps and bathymetry models must be read with scale, labels, depth values, and feature evidence. In this item, the evidence from Map/model/data stimulus should be used to explain ocean maps, bathymetry, sonar evidence, scale, and seafloor features.
